applicationCapture.executable.reason: The application picker supplies the executable identity.

applicationCapture.executablePath.reason: The application picker supplies the observed executable path.

applicationCapture.processId.reason: The application picker supplies the numeric process ID.

applicationCapture.creationTime100ns.reason: The application picker supplies the observed process creation time.

applicationCapture.processPolicy.reason: Optional backend rebinding policy; Properties has no separate policy control.

endpointLoopback.endpointId.reason: Selected while creating the source in Advanced troubleshooting; there is no editable Properties control.

endpointLoopback.defaultRole.reason: Optional API binding; Properties has no follow-default-role control.

audioFile.fileName.reason: The file chooser supplies the display filename with the uploaded media ID.

soundboard.slot<N>FileName.reason: Each sound chooser supplies its filename; button 1 represents the repeated chooser family.

soundboard.slot<N>Set.reason: Sound sets are configurable by API; the Properties set picker is not implemented (carried owner gate).
